entry.title: Lightning Nodes Drained As BTCPay Server Users Race To Patch
entry.summary: Hardware wallet maker Foundation and the Bitcoin zine Citadel21 both said their nodes were swept, in some cases hours before the project's public alert. BTCPay says the flaw under attack is not the one disclosed in its changelog.

entry.title: Solana Perp DEX Flash Trade to Wind Down Unless It Finds a Buyer
entry.summary: Any proceeds from a sale of the exchange's tech stack, brand and IP go to FAF holders pro rata, with team tokens excluded from the distribution.

entry.title: SharpLink Opposes Ethereum Proposal to Burn a Growing Share of Validator Rewards
entry.summary: Joseph Chalom argues the draft would strip the base rate out from under roughly $35 billion in liquid staking token collateral and could push institutions to sell ETH as they unstake.

entry.title: Rarible Launches Solana NFT Marketplace With Claynosaurz as First Collection
entry.summary: Rarible's site now lists Solana alongside Ethereum, MegaETH and Base, with dedicated Explore, Mint and Gacha pages for the network.

entry.title: Tokyo Lawson Register Scans a Barcode for a 322-Yen JPYC Stablecoin Payment
entry.summary: Store-side acceptance ran inside Lawson's existing register through HashPort Wallet for Biz and Canal Payment Service's PAYTREE gateway, with no dedicated stablecoin terminal added at the till.

entry.title: Black Lake Launches Harbor Verify to Bring Verifiable Credit to Onchain Markets
entry.summary: Black Lake Digital Markets has launched Harbor Verify, a browser-based tool that lets investors, lenders, auditors, and rating agencies independently confirm that every loan in a tokenized pool belongs there and passed its published eligibility rules, without seeing private borrower data.

entry.title: ether.fi Removes Restaking From weETH, Nearing A Full EigenLayer Exit
entry.summary: Restaking exposure moves into weETHs, a separate token built on Symbiotic. CEO Mike Silagadze: “End of an era. Sad.”

entry.title: Uniswap's New Launchpad Out-Launched Pons On Its First Day On Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: Pools.trade opened on Aug. 5 charging no launchpad fee and created 10,506 tokens that day against Pons' 7,210. Uniswap says the product does not change its support for the launchpads already built on its protocol. Some traders disagree. PONS is down 49% on the week.

entry.title: Robinhood Chain's DEX Volume Fell 72% While Transactions And Deposits Set Records
entry.summary: Daily volume dropped from $878 million on Jul. 11 to $241 million on Aug. 1 as transactions, deposits and stablecoin supply climbed to all-time highs. Volume per transaction fell 74%. More than 90% of the chain's incentive spending pays depositors.

entry.title: a16z's Miles Jennings Says Banks Fighting the CLARITY Act Are 'Accelerating Their Own Obsolescence'
entry.summary: Six banking trade groups are still pressing senators to tighten the bill's prohibition on interest-like rewards for holding stablecoins, a payment Jennings says will continue under GENIUS if CLARITY dies.

entry.title: Sentora Opens A Lending Vault Against Wellington's First Native Onchain Credit Strategy
entry.summary: The Morpho vault holds $9.6 million of PayPal's stablecoin and lends against mWIN, a Luxembourg-issued token whose bond portfolio Wellington Management runs. Of the 8.31% headline yield, 7.61 percentage points come from a PYUSD reward stream.

entry.title: Uniswap Ships A Memecoin Launchpad On Robinhood Chain, Topped By $FRONG Token Minted Six Days Early
entry.summary: Pools opened four and a half hours behind its own countdown. Uniswap Labs claims the product and disclaims every token on it, including FRONG, the frog memecoin named after its teaser video that leads the platform at a $12.1 million valuation.

entry.title: Aave And ether.fi Founders Lead Opposition To Ethereum's Staking Yield Burn
entry.summary: Stani Kulechov and Mike Silagadze headline two days of opposition to the tapered issuance burn, now renumbered EIP-8363. Ethereum core devs decide Thursday whether to consider it for Hegotá.

entry.title: Traders Push CLARITY Act Odds Into 2027 After Thune Skips Cloture Filing
entry.summary: Kalshi's Sept. 1 contract now trades at 2 cents, while the price on enactment before Jan. 1, 2028 ticked up, moving the implied probability out of this year and into the next.

entry.title: Dinari Opens 724 Tokenized US Stocks to Eligible US Investors
entry.summary: Dividends on Dinari's dShares now pay out natively in USDC, while 24/7 trading and T+0 settlement remain future capabilities the company says depend on regulatory requirements.

entry.title: Circle Names BlackRock, Visa, ICE and DTCC Among 11 Founding Arc Validators
entry.summary: Circle's own disclaimer says Arc will be "operated by a permissioned validator set" and has not been reviewed by the New York State Department of Financial Services or any other regulator.

entry.title: Nomura’s Laser Digital Backs ZIGChain’s Emerging-Market Private Credit Push
entry.summary: Laser Digital bought ZIG tokens and will structure and risk-govern a pipeline of vault products with ZIG Markets, which says it has originated more than $50 million with no defaults so far. The investment size was not disclosed.

entry.title: Pirate Nation Studio Proof of Play Shuts Down, Open-Sources Code and Art
entry.summary: The studio released the Pirate Nation Unity app and smart contracts on GitHub and put its artwork, IP and Founder Pirates NFTs into the public domain under a CC0 license.

entry.title: Eliza Labs' Shaw Walters Says ai16z Token Is 'Dead' After Settling Burwick Law Class Action
entry.summary: The token that once carried a $2.5 billion market capitalization is now worth about $305,000, and Walters says he owns none of it.

entry.title: Mastercard Extends Crypto Credential to Cross-Border Stablecoin Payments in Borderless.xyz Pilot
entry.summary: The pilot, whose first participants are Infinia, Walapay and Koywe, will test whether compliance checks performed once at origination can be relied on across Borderless.xyz's network of stablecoin payment providers.

entry.title: Cloudflare Launches Stablecoin Wallets for AI Agents, Opens cloudflare.pay Handles
entry.summary: Account owners hold stablecoins and issue capped Virtual Wallets to their agents. Handle reservations open Tuesday; funding, onramps and agent spending arrive “in the coming months.”

entry.title: Western Union and Rain Launch Stablecoin Card in 37 Markets
entry.summary: Stablecard holds remittances as USDPT, the Anchorage-issued Solana token Western Union launched in May, and spends the balance anywhere Visa is accepted. The stablecoin behind it has $7.4 million in circulation.

entry.title: New Ethereum Proposal Would Burn Validator Rewards to Kill the Incentive to Stake More
entry.summary: EIP-8361 would deduct a rising share of every validator's rewards as the staking ratio climbs, cancelling consensus issuance outright at 50%. It landed two days before the deadline to propose EIPs for Hegotá, and the timing drew an objection within hours.

entry.title: Wells Fargo to Launch Tokenized Deposits for Corporate Clients This Fall
entry.summary: The bank will start with a limited U.S. dollar-to-British pound corridor and widen it through 2027. It names neither the blockchain it is using nor whether the ledger is permissioned.

entry.title: BitGo Names Chainlink CCIP Exclusive Cross-Chain Provider for $7.7 Billion WBTC
entry.summary: BitGo will move Wrapped Bitcoin and every future BitGo-issued asset onto Chainlink CCIP, dropping the provider it chose in September 2024. The announcement never uses the word LayerZero.

entry.title: BitMine Buys 10,399 More ETH but Reported Holdings Fall to $11.3B
entry.summary: Cash and marketable securities dropped to $173 million from $268 million after BitMine repurchased another 4.5 million shares, lifting buybacks since July 1 to 16.1 million.

entry.title: Fake World Assets Boosts Buybacks to 80% of Fees After Token Crashes to Record Low
entry.summary: TokenWorks reversed course twice in under 24 hours after FWA holders learned none of the roughly $3.2 million in launch-period revenue would fund buybacks, sending the token down more than 40%.

entry.title: Robinhood's Second Venture Fund Targets Y Combinator Startups in $200 Million IPO
entry.summary: Retail investors can request RVII shares at an expected $25 apiece through Aug. 12, ahead of an NYSE listing set for Aug. 13 — five months after Robinhood's first venture fund raised $658.4 million to buy into companies like OpenAI and Stripe.

entry.title: Bitcoin Bridge Boltz Halts Swaps Indefinitely, Citing AI-Assisted Attacks
entry.summary: The non-custodial swap service said attackers now iterate faster than its team can patch, leaving wallets including Aqua and Bull Bitcoin racing to restore Lightning and Liquid swaps.

entry.title: Tornado Cash Logs 968 Deposits in Busiest Day of 2026, L2Beat Says
entry.summary: The July 23 spike — worth about $57 million in ETH — was driven largely by the Drift exploiter, who pushed $44 million through the mixer in under two hours.

entry.title: Flap Overtakes Pump.fun in Daily Revenue With $1.18 Million
entry.summary: The BNB Chain launchpad's fees grew 40x in two weeks, making it the second BNB Chain platform to flip the Solana incumbent.

entry.title: DEX Spot Volume Hit a Record 24% of CEX Volume in July
entry.summary: Decentralized exchanges took their largest share of spot trading since tracking began in 2019 — in a month when overall volumes sank to a two-year low.

entry.title: RWAs Topped Half of Hyperliquid's Volume for Two Straight Weeks in July
entry.summary: Perpetual futures tied to stocks, indexes and commodities out-traded crypto pairs on the largest perps DEX for the first time, less than a year after builder-deployed markets went live.

entry.title: Crypto Card Volume Hits $748.7M in July, a Fifth Straight Monthly Gain: Paymentscan
entry.summary: Spending on crypto payment cards jumped 19% to a monthly record, with RedotPay handling more than half the volume as flows into stablecoin neobanks crossed $1 billion for the first time.

entry.title: Strategy Sells 1,638 Bitcoin for $105M, Splits Proceeds Between Dividends and STRC Buyback
entry.summary: The company raised its USD Reserve to $4.0 billion from $3.0 billion three weeks earlier, funding the increase with $250 million from the sale of 3,011,361 MSTR shares.

entry.title: 'I Did Everything Right': Coldcard Victims Recount Losing Life Savings
entry.summary: Bitcoiners who followed self-custody best practices — air-gapped devices, steel seed plates, safety deposit boxes — describe watching years of savings disappear in minutes as attackers exploiting the Coldcard flaw drained more than $114 million.

entry.title: The $114 Trillion Question: How DTCC Is Tokenizing the Entire U.S. Market
entry.summary: DTCC holds $114 trillion in assets. On July 15th, it showed the world how those assets can be converted into digital tokens, traded in real production conditions, and converted back — without disrupting anything.

entry.title: Coldcard Thefts Near $114 Million as Fourth Attack Wave Hits
entry.summary: A firmware bug that shipped in 2021 made Coldcard seeds guessable, and attackers have drained more than 1,800 BTC since Thursday. The latest sweep can still be outbid in the mempool, giving some victims a window to rescue their coins.

entry.title: YGG Play Shuts Down Services as Yield Guild Pivots to AI Data
entry.summary: Yield Guild's own sunset document retires the YGGPlay.fun site, Launchpad and questing platform by August 1, while GIGACHADBAT and Ragnarok Breaker continue under Delabs Games and Planetarium Labs.

entry.title: Metronome Discloses $15.7 Million Synth Shortfall, Blames Oracle Lag in Swap Module
entry.summary: MetronomeDAO says 6,367 msETH and 4.57 million msUSD lack backing after years of "unbacked float" accumulated through Chainlink price-feed latency; the treasury has staged $34 million in defensive positions to close the gap.

entry.title: Coinbase Says Revenue From Its Base Layer 2 Fell Despite Record Volume
entry.summary: Coinbase's Q2 filings show sequencer revenue from Base declined even as stablecoin transaction volume on the network grew sevenfold year-over-year.

entry.title: Bitcoin Lags Stock Rally After Hawkish Fed Hold
entry.summary: BTC slipped 2.5% Friday as equities surged, closing a July in which the Fed's fifth straight hold and 3.7% PCE inflation shut the door on near-term rate cuts. Uniswap led weekly gainers; Worldcoin sank.

entry.title: Polygon Turns Kansai Electric Loyalty Points Into JPYC Spending
entry.summary: Rewards earned in the utility giant's MOACT app now convert into Japan's regulated yen stablecoin, usable across DeFi through HashPort Wallet.

entry.title: ENS Scales Back Plan to Move DAO Treasury Control to New Foundation
entry.summary: The executable draft adds Security Council oversight of Endowment transactions and narrows the Foundation's initial token grant to 1 million ENS after delegates called the earlier plan a "governance attack."

entry.title: Uniswap Protocol Revenue Nearly Triples After v4 Fee Switch as UNI Tops $4
entry.summary: Three days of onchain data show the expanded fee switch is delivering for UNI holders — about $325,000 a day now flows toward UNI burns, and the token is up 16% on the week. Liquidity providers and rival DEX founders say that money comes out of their pockets, and Uniswap's own documentation shows

entry.title: Ready Shuts Card Program After Issuer Kulipa's Sudden Wind-Down
entry.summary: Self-custodial wallet says user funds are untouched as the collapse of a shared card issuer knocks out Ready, Solflare and other crypto card programs overnight.

entry.title: Banco Santander Discloses Spot Bitcoin ETF Stake in 13F Filing
entry.summary: The Spanish lender's Q2 2026 filing lists a position in BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, the largest spot Bitcoin ETF.

entry.title: US Sanctions Iranian Marine Insurers Taking Bitcoin for Strait of Hormuz Passage
entry.summary: Treasury says HormuzSafe, developed by Iran's Ministry of Economy, accepted digital assets to fund an IRGC-backed 'extortion' scheme targeting commercial shipping.

entry.title: Aave Moves to Retire 50 Low-Adoption Assets, Wind Down Six Chains
entry.summary: Kulechov says the $98 million cleanup 'should not be interpreted as a view on any L1 or L2' as the lending giant narrows its focus to high-value markets.

entry.title: Lightning Labs Launches Site for L402 Bitcoin Agent Payments
entry.summary: The protocol, which lets AI agents pay Lightning invoices to access API endpoints, already runs inside Lightning Loop; the new site is the launch.

entry.title: Bitcoin Slips Below $64K After Warsh Says "No Soft Inflation Target"
entry.summary: Crypto's relief pop after the Fed's 9-3 hold faded within the hour as the new chair's hawkish press conference dragged risk assets lower.

entry.title: Active Crypto VC Firms Fall to 150, Lowest Since 2020
entry.summary: The July count sits far below the 1,177 unique investors CryptoRank recorded at the March 2022 peak, pointing to a smaller, more selective pool of backers.

entry.title: Morgan Stanley Launches Spot Ether, Solana ETPs on NYSE Arca
entry.summary: The MSSE and MSOL trusts each charge a 0.14% expense ratio and will stake a portion of holdings, passing rewards to investors.

entry.title: SoFi Says SoFiUSD Settlement Now Live on Q2 Earnings Call
entry.summary: The bank tied the stablecoin's first live settlements to real-time commercial payments running through its Big Business Banking platform on Solana.

entry.title: Morpho Signs First Hong Kong Partnership With HashKey's HSK Chain
entry.summary: Morpho will deploy on HSK Chain and become its official onchain credit partner as the lending network pushes into Asia's institutional market.

entry.title: Safe Logs 130M Transactions in Q2, a Quarterly Record
entry.summary: The smart-account provider ended the quarter with 63.4 million Safes deployed and pushed its Safenet Beta live with 54.8 million SAFE staked.

entry.title: 10 European Banks Launch RL1 Blockchain Cooperative
entry.summary: RL1 inherits SWIAT's production network, which processed more than €700 million in transactions over three years before ownership moved to the Luxembourg cooperative.

entry.title: Crypto Hacks Hit Record 212 Incidents in H1 2026: Blockaid
entry.summary: North Korea-linked actors drove the largest losses, with the $292M KelpDAO and $285M Drift exploits both tied to DPRK groups.

entry.title: Robinhood Chain Tops Solana in Tokenized Stock Volume Via Memecoin Pairs
entry.summary: Tokenized stocks on Robinhood's three-week-old chain averaged $29.7 million in daily DEX volume over the past week, more than Solana's xStocks and Backpack venues combined, with memecoin pairs supplying the push.

entry.title: Zama CEO Claims 1,000 Confidential Transfers Per Second on GPUs
entry.summary: Rand Hindi said the fully homomorphic encryption benchmark is not yet live on mainnet, with activation planned for end of year.

entry.title: 1inch Commits 10M 1INCH, 500k USDC to Aqua LP Rewards
entry.summary: The three-month campaign runs through Merkl across 80+ 1INCH markets, with BNB Chain named as the first co-incentive partner.

entry.title: NFT Gacha Protocol Fake World Assets Trails Only Sky in Ethereum Daily Revenue
entry.summary: The two-developer project overtook Solana's dominant tokenized-card platform four days after relaunching, generating $1.6M in daily fees at its peak before activity cooled.

entry.title: Franklin Templeton Backs CLARITY Act as Wall Street Coalition Grows
entry.summary: The $1.79 trillion asset manager joins BlackRock, Fidelity and Goldman Sachs in backing the crypto market-structure bill as senators review updated Senate text.

entry.title: Ondo Recasts Its Blockchain as the Ondo Network
entry.summary: CEO Ian De Bode says the company will not run the new execution layer and the earlier Ondo Chain in parallel, and that the network 'isn't a blockchain today.'

entry.title: Ether ETFs Pull $104M, Tripling Bitcoin's Weekly Inflows
entry.summary: BlackRock's ETHA absorbed $96 million while its bitcoin fund IBIT bled $95 million, the second straight week ether products out-drew their bitcoin counterparts.

entry.title: World Enters 'Phase 3,' Extends Proof of Human to AI Agents
entry.summary: Three years after launch, the Sam Altman-backed identity project is winding down token-incentivized growth and betting its next stage on paid verification for enterprises, consumer apps, and AI agents.

entry.title: Phantom to End Monad Support on Aug. 26
entry.summary: The wallet is dropping the EVM chain nine months after its mainnet launch, a day after adding Robinhood Chain. Monad co-founder Keone Hon called the move "a step backward," while MetaMask offered to cover migrating users' gas fees.

entry.title: Storj Files Chapter 11, Floats Equity Path for Token Holders
entry.summary: The decentralized storage firm says its network keeps running and its parent, Inveniam, backs the reorganization, as STORJ falls about 18% in 24 hours.

entry.title: Lido Unveils Curated Module v2 in Ethereum Staking Overhaul
entry.summary: The liquid staking protocol is migrating more than 8 million staked ETH onto a module that requires node operators to post bonds, a shift expected to cut Ethereum's validator count by about a third.

entry.title: Circle Buys IBM Blockchain Patent Portfolio
entry.summary: The USDC issuer says the roughly 1,000-patent haul makes it the leading US blockchain patent holder, with financial terms undisclosed.

entry.title: Magic Labs Sells Wallet Business to Kraken Parent Payward
entry.summary: The embedded-wallet pioneer is rebranding as Newton Labs to focus on an onchain authorization layer that vets transactions against policy before they settle.

entry.title: Securitize Registers Capital Affiliate as SEC Investment Adviser
entry.summary: Securitize Capital's registration took effect July 22, SEC records show, adding an advisory license to the tokenization firm's U.S. regulatory lineup three weeks after its NYSE debut.

entry.title: Coinbase Opens 'Launches' Tab for New Base, Solana Tokens
entry.summary: The feature routes users into Coinbase's built-in DEX, which its product page says is not available in all locations and requires a self-custody wallet.

entry.title: BitMart to Wind Down Exchange, End Trading by Aug. 26
entry.summary: The exchange gave no specific reason for the closure, and its BMX token fell about 59% in 24 hours after the announcement.

entry.title: Perp DEX Dango to Wind Down, Will Halt Trading July 29
entry.summary: The Hack VC-backed Layer 1 will shut its blockchain on Aug. 13 and return user funds as USDC, closing out a mainnet run of under four months that began with a $1.9 million exploit.

entry.title: India Orders GitHub to Remove Jack Dorsey's Bitchat Code
entry.summary: India's cybercrime agency gave GitHub three hours to pull three Bitchat repositories, objecting to the mesh messaging app's ability to work during internet shutdowns amid protests in New Delhi. Digital rights advocates called the order unconstitutional.

entry.title: Ex-Sushi CTO Joseph DeLong to Launch Order Book DEX on Robinhood Chain
entry.summary: The former SushiSwap CTO described the decentralized exchange as a side project that 'outgrew nights and weekends,' with no specs, contract, or token disclosed.

entry.title: Stacks Bitcoin Staking Upgrade Vote Passes With 99%, Muneeb Says
entry.summary: Most exchanges and partners have signaled readiness for the hard fork, though a few are still reviewing details and the upgrade has not yet activated.

entry.title: Samsung Says Wallet Will Add Stablecoin Support
entry.summary: The announcement at Galaxy Unpacked in London came with no timeline, issuers, or markets — but would put stablecoins on hundreds of millions of phones.

entry.title: BitMEX, Hayes Sued Over 623 BTC Liquidation Claims as Exchange Winds Down
entry.summary: A proposed class action landed in New York federal court the same day BitMEX announced it will close on Sept. 23, reviving allegations the exchange pocketed customer collateral.good job I as

entry.title: Odos to Shut Down DEX Aggregator on July 30
entry.summary: Monthly volume on the once top-five aggregator collapsed 98% from its $7.85B peak in December 2024. Users with social-login wallets must move assets before the deadline.

entry.title: OCC Denies Wise's US National Trust Bank Charter
entry.summary: The regulator cited money-laundering risk concerns in a rare rejection amid a wave of crypto charter approvals. Wise plans to refile under the GENIUS Act.

entry.title: Hacker Behind Fake 'Vladhood' Token Still Collecting Fees After Robinhood CEO's X Account Hack
entry.summary: Onchain records show the scam token was deployed 46 minutes before the hacked post appeared, and that its creator has been harvesting trading fees — without ever pulling liquidity

entry.title: Ondo's Oasis Pro Markets Cleared to Offer Tokenized Stocks in US
entry.summary: The tokenization firm said its broker-dealer subsidiary can now sell tokenized equities, ETFs and funds to American investors under SEC and FINRA oversight.

entry.title: Uniswap Adds Permissioned Pools to Bring Regulated Assets to v4
entry.summary: The v4 hook enforces issuer allowlists onchain at the protocol level, with Superstate, Securitize, and Dowgo as launch partners.

entry.title: KAIO Tokenizes Mubadala Capital Fund Across Base, Solana and Sui
entry.summary: Coinbase will add exposure to the tokenized private-markets offering, which launched with about $75M in onchain value, KAIO said.

entry.title: SEC's Peirce Says Onchain Vaults, Lending Can Trigger Securities Laws
entry.summary: The Commissioner known as 'Crypto Mom' framed the statement as an invitation to engage rather than an enforcement threat, warning builders who twist the law that they "will have a painful fall."

entry.title: BitMEX to Shut Down Exchange on Sept. 23, Urges Withdrawals
entry.summary: Owner HDR Global Trading blamed a strategic review; users have until an Aug. 26 risk-limit cutover before positions get force-closed.

entry.title: Attacker Drains $24M in USDC From AFX Bridge on Arbitrum
entry.summary: The exploit targeted a bridge operated by derivatives exchange AFX and emptied nearly all of the USDC locked in the contract, according to security firm Blockaid. Arbitrum co-founder Steven Goldfeder said the network's native bridge was not affected.

entry.title: Crypto Industry Pushes for Senate Vote on New CLARITY Act Text as Democrats Blast Ethics Plan
entry.summary: Coinbase, the Blockchain Association and the DeFi Education Fund urged the Senate to pass the 616-page merged draft, while Sen. Angela Alsobrooks called its DOJ-led ethics enforcement "wild and unserious and stone-cold crazy."

entry.title: Tokenized Stocks Hit Records Across Every Major Venue as Sector Reaches $2.3B
entry.summary: Ondo, Backed Finance, and Robinhood Chain all set all-time highs in tokenized equity holdings this week, while dYdX's new Arcus exchange posted record perps volume — signs the market for onchain stocks is scaling on multiple fronts at once.

entry.title: Robinhood Chain Overtakes Base on Daily Active Users Three Weeks After Launch
entry.summary: The Arbitrum Orbit network posted 324,000 daily active users and a record $588.9 million in TVL on July 21, edging out Coinbase's L2 on activity — though memecoins, not the tokenized stocks it was built for, are driving most of the volume.

entry.title: Ostium to Reopen Trading July 23 After $23.8M Vault Exploit
entry.summary: Positions will be marked to the live market price at reopen, and new OLP liquidity-provider deposits stay paused as the protocol works through recovery.

entry.title: Franklin Templeton Says Altcoins Are Key to the Agentic AI Trade
entry.summary: Digital assets head Sandy Kaul argues card rails can't handle $0.001 machine payments, making blockchain tokens the way to capture agentic AI value.

entry.title: Ramp Adds Stablecoin Accounts and Bill Pay on Stripe Stack
entry.summary: Bridge converts dollars for Bill Pay while Privy stores balances, splitting the roles across Stripe's stablecoin infrastructure.

entry.title: Crypto Rallies as Reported Ethics Deal Revives Odds of CLARITY Act Senate Vote
entry.summary: Bitcoin reclaimed $66,000 after reports that the White House circulated agreed-upon ethics-provision language to Senate Republicans, removing the main obstacle to a floor vote before the August recess.

entry.title: S&P and Pantera Launch Revenue-Screened Digital Asset Index
entry.summary: The 18-constituent benchmark excludes Bitcoin and meme coins, screening for protocols with positive revenue verified by onchain data.

entry.title: Movement Labs Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
entry.summary: The company behind the MOVE token filed a voluntary petition in Delaware listing up to $10 million in liabilities, capping a year of governance disputes, a market-making scandal and a failed strategic pivot.

entry.title: Durov Says Telegram Will Ship Native Gram Wallet to a Billion Users
entry.summary: The Telegram founder is putting private-key custody inside the core app this summer, a distribution reach no self-custody wallet has attempted.

entry.title: Ondo Enables Tokenized Stock Collateral on OndoPerps
entry.summary: Ondo Stocks holders can now back perpetual futures positions with SPYon and QQQon, subject to an initial $100,000 per-asset notional cap.
